title: Top-Performer Relief Around the Warning Points Threshold (Seller Performance Standing)
content:
**Band rule.** How the top-performer rate is applied depends on where the active points for top-performer relief stand against the warning points threshold of the seller's level: when they are at or above the threshold and no violation was recorded in the last six whole calendar months, the points above the threshold come off in full and the threshold points are multiplied by the top-performer rate; when they are at or above the threshold and a violation was recorded in that period, the threshold points are multiplied by the top-performer rate and the points above it by twice that rate, and the two products are added; when they are below the threshold, all the active points are multiplied by the top-performer rate.

Under Seller Performance Standing the warning points threshold is 8 points at Top Rated Level and at Preferred Partner Level, as at every other level. A violation of any type counts for the six-month test; a violation lies in the last six whole calendar months when fewer than six whole months have passed from its recording date to the handling date, counted by calendar date.

## The three bands

| Active points for top-performer relief | Violation recorded in the last six whole calendar months | Relief points |
|---|---|---|
| 8 or more | none | the active points less 8, in full, plus 8 multiplied by the rate |
| 8 or more | one or more | 8 multiplied by the rate, plus the active points less 8 multiplied by twice the rate |
| 7 or fewer | either | the active points multiplied by the rate |

The relief points are kept to four decimal places; they are not rounded on their own, the rounding down to a whole point being applied to the top-performer relief as a whole.

## Worked figures (hypothetical, rate 0.3)

- 11 active points, no violation in the last six months: 3 points above the threshold in full, plus 8 multiplied by 0.3, which is 2.4; relief points 5.4.
- 11 active points, a violation recorded four months ago: 8 multiplied by 0.3 is 2.4; 3 multiplied by 0.6 is 1.8; relief points 4.2.
- 6 active points: 6 multiplied by 0.3 is 1.8; relief points 1.8.
- Exactly 8 active points, no violation in the last six months: nothing above the threshold, plus 2.4; relief points 2.4.
